title: Design System: Sims 4 Mod Manager native

label.purpose: Authors, ownership, file counts and installed state.

nativeStates.contextMenuSelection: Right-click selects the clicked card or list identity before opening the shared mod menu.
nativeStates.settingsSelection: Header Settings toggles the full-page route; Back to library and wide library filters return to browsing.

nativeComponents.name: Management actions
nativeComponents.description: Library imports and restore; selected-mod controls live in the inspector or narrow details.

nativeComponents.name: More actions and context menu
nativeComponents.description: Shared reviewed actions for the selected mod; right-click selects the clicked identity in cards and lists.

nativeComponents.name: Settings page
nativeComponents.description: Full-page preferences with persistent Save settings and Back to library above scrollable form content.

nativeComponents.name: Custom-theme editor
nativeComponents.description: Name and six hex/color-picker controls, reset, JSON copy/import for editing and validated save.

nativeComponents.name: Status and activity
nativeComponents.description: Bottom status, notices and errors with disclosed operation history.

nativeComponents.name: CurseForge browser
nativeComponents.description: Provider search, category and sort controls, result counts and pagination using the existing native theme.

nativeComponents.name: CurseForge project card
nativeComponents.description: Provider logo, name, author, bounded summary and metadata with aligned header, summary and View details rows.

nativeComponents.name: CurseForge project details
nativeComponents.description: Pinned Back to results above full summary, categories, supplied links and screenshots in one scroll region.

extensions.documentationNote: Native egui components have no HTML/CSS runtime. Native component records replace web snippets; no HTML/CSS design detector applies. No invented tonal ramps or motion values are added.

nativeSettings.save: Save settings and Save custom theme validate, apply and persist the custom draft.
nativeSettings.settingsThemeSelection: Built-in and saved-theme choices apply immediately; Save settings persists them.
nativeSettings.headerThemeToggle: Applies and persists light/dark mode while preserving custom colors and the editor draft. Use default colors explicitly restores the built-in palette.
nativeSettings.transfer: Settings export omits customThemes and activeCustomTheme for compatibility with older version-1 transfers; separate theme JSON transfers custom colors.
nativeSettings.importPreservation: An empty or absent custom-theme collection preserves the local collection; an omitted API key preserves the local key.

nativeDiscovery.theme: Existing light/dark roles; no new color tokens.
nativeDiscovery.navigation: My mods and Browse mods below the logo; browser uses the full central panel without the library rail.

layout.shortWindow: Below 600 points of content height, Filters folds the selectors with an active type/category/version count. Expanded controls scroll with results; Clear filters remains reachable.
layout.projectScroll: Back to results remains above the scroll region.

filterGroups.labels: Above selectors; groups wrap together without horizontal overflow.

states.cardHoverAndFocus: Existing selection stroke inside the 8-point card border when hovered or focused.
states.search: Search or Enter submits; content type, category, version and sort changes restart at index zero. Pagination retains every submitted dimension.
states.counts: Provider pagination supplies result count, range and Previous/Next availability.
states.setup: Connect to CurseForge with Open Settings and instructions to save a local API key.
states.error: Search unavailable with provider-specific guidance, Open Settings and Try again.
states.categoryError: Visible warning; available projects remain shown.
states.return: Back to results or Escape restores the current page; Ctrl+F returns to browser search.
states.browseBy: Provider root classes: Mods, Create a Sim, Build / Buy, Rooms / Lots, Sims / Households, Pets, Save Files, Worlds and Translations.
states.category: Searchable full parent paths scoped to the selected content type; changing type clears category.
states.gameVersion: Searchable numeric Sims 4 provider versions, newest first.
states.sortSemantics: Relevancy omits sortField for provider default ranking. Date released uses public API release-date sort 11; the website Creation Date sort is unavailable. Popularity uses 2, Latest update 3, Total Downloads 6 and A-Z 4 ascending.
states.clearFilters: Resets content type, category and game version while retaining search text and sort.
states.filterOptionLoading: Worker loads category and version options only when missing or after a failed attempt.

nativeDiscovery.scope: Current browser supports provider search and in-app inspection using the saved local key. Filtering saves no credentials or source metadata and does not download, update or attach mods. Future download and update actions require user initiation.

verification.fixtureContent: Synthetic test projects and procedural images, not provider results.

verification.liveProvider: Passed core/tests/curseforge_browse.rs::live_browse_filters_respect_provider_taxonomy with a local ignored key: all nine content types, combined Mods / Gameplay / 1.128.90 filters, filtered pagination, real file-version evidence, Relevancy and Date released requests.

narrative.overview:
The native library follows the user-approved Deadlock Mod Manager and CurseForge direction. Large previews carry recognition; warm neutral surfaces, gold selection and visible installed state keep local management clear. The light and dark themes share the same hierarchy.

This design applies to the Linux Fastframe/egui app. The Rust implementation is authoritative. Dimensions use egui logical points, not CSS pixels. Fastframe supplies default fonts and platform text rendering.
keyCharacteristics: Photo cards by default, with a compact list switch.
Warm light and charcoal dark themes with gold selection.
A persistent inspector on wide windows and a return path on narrow windows.

rules.name: readable metadata
rules.body: Use the explicit muted theme color for secondary text; do not substitute egui's default weak alpha for it.

dos: Do preserve photo proportions with destination-aware centered cover crops in cards and contain sizing in the inspector.
Do keep explicit weak text colors readable on panels, cards, widgets and selected fills.
Do preserve search and selected identity when switching card/list layouts.
Do show No Preview for missing or broken mod photos and keep weak source-match warnings visible.
Do require user initiation for future mod downloads and updates.
donts: Don't fabricate mod photography, authors, source candidates or discovery counters.
Don't replace native focus and hover behavior with a custom selection animation.
